Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Disarm has the limiting text "not usable by a vampire going into
torpor".

Is it usable by a vampire being burned? From one point of view,
a vampire being burned in combat is already burned and therefore
unable to play any cards when the round is ending, but then again,
there could be effects that would save him from being burned.

Is it usable by a dying ally? Pulled Fangs actually has text
saying "not usable by a dying ally or a vampire going into torpor"
which implies that without such text it would be usable by a dying
ally... and if by a dying ally, why not by a dying vampire?

thanks,

Josh

weird questions that have apparently weirdly not been answered before

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
>
> Disarm has the limiting text "not usable by a vampire going into
> torpor".
>
> Is it usable by a vampire being burned?

Combat
* Cards which are not usable by vampires going to Torpor are not usable
by vampires burned in combat, either. [RTR 19950622]

> Is it usable by a dying ally?

No.
